= Dried Kelp Farm =
A '''Dried Kelp Farm''' is an automated farm used to produce large amounts of '''Kelp''', which is smelted and crafted into '''Dried Kelp Block'''.

These farms are designed to run continuously and are commonly used by players to produce dried kelp blocks in large quantities for selling through orders or for use as fuel.
----

== Overview ==
Dried kelp farms are automated redstone machines designed to:

# Grow kelp in vertical water columns
# Harvest the kelp automatically using pistons
# Transport the drops through water streams
# Smelt kelp into dried kelp
# Craft dried kelp into blocks

Most farms are built so the entire process—from harvesting to smelting—runs automatically.
----

== Mechanics ==
Kelp farming relies on the natural growth mechanics of kelp.

* Kelp grows upward in water blocks.
* Plants can grow several blocks tall.
* Breaking part of the plant causes the upper pieces to drop as items.

In most farms, kelp is harvested using '''pistons that are constantly powered by redstone'''. When kelp grows into the piston area, the piston breaks the plant and the items drop into the water stream.

The collection and processing system typically works as follows:

# Pistons break the kelp.
# Water streams carry the kelp items across the farm.
# Items flow into '''hoppers placed above smokers'''.
# Smokers smelt the kelp into dried kelp.
# The dried kelp is crafted into dried kelp blocks.

This setup allows large farms to process kelp efficiently while running automatically.
----

== Profitability ==
Dried kelp farms are widely used because they provide '''consistent passive income'''.

Players commonly sell dried kelp blocks through '''orders''', where buyers purchase large quantities at once.

Another way that people make money from Dried Kelp Blocks is by abusing sell multipliers. Because Dried Kelp Blocks are sold on /sell for $300 each with a 1.0x multiplier. This means that if you have over a 2.5x multi, you will get profit by ordering the blocks and simply clicking "sell all". LrexTTV uses this method and has sold $15T worth in dried kelp blocks. 

Warning: DO NOT DO THIS IF YOU HAVE BELOW A 2.5X MULTI -- YOU WILL LOSE MONEY

Larger farms produce significantly more kelp per hour, increasing the amount of dried kelp blocks that can be sold.
----

== Kelpulator Tool ==
Many players estimate the potential output of their farms before building them.

A commonly used calculator is:

'''Kelpulator'''

https://kelpulator.vercel.app/

This tool helps calculate:

* Total kelp production
* Smelting output
* Dried kelp block totals
* Estimated earnings

By entering the size or production rate of a farm, players can estimate how much dried kelp their farm will generate.
